original_question: What are the essential dimension ed(PGL_n) and essential p-dimension ed_p(PGL_n) of the projective linear group? In particular, what are ed_F(PGL_4) in characteristic 2 and ed_F(PGL_5)?
target_in_paper: Section 6, Problem 6.2: compute the essential dimension and the essential p-dimension of PGL_n; specifically, the paper then asks (1) to compute ed(PGL_4) when char(F)=2 and (2) to compute ed(PGL_5). ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper's actual target very closely: it correctly centers on PGL_n, asks about both essential dimension and essential p-dimension, and isolates the same two highlighted small cases that the paper singles out, namely ed_F(PGL_4) in characteristic 2 and ed_F(PGL_5). ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))
missing_details: The base field should be explicit: the paper defines essential dimension relative to a fixed field F, so the relevant objects are ed_F(PGL_n) and ed_{F,p}(PGL_n). ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))

The question should specify that PGL_n is viewed through the functor K/F ↦ H^1(K,PGL_n), since essential dimension is defined for that functor, not as an abstract invariant of the bare group symbol. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))

The meaning of essential p-dimension should be stated: it is defined using fields of definition after allowing finite extensions of degree prime to p, with p a prime. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))

To make the question stand-alone and faithful to the paper's algebraic intent, it should mention the equivalent interpretation via isomorphism classes of central simple K-algebras of degree n. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))

Among the two indented subproblems, the paper asks only for ordinary essential dimension: determine ed_F(PGL_4) when char(F)=2, and determine ed_F(PGL_5). It does not separately single out ed_{F,p} for those two bullets. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))

The paper notes that these are the smallest unknown cases, which explains why they are singled out; your draft implies this emphasis but does not state it. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))
refined_question: Let F be a field, let n be a positive integer, and let p be a prime. For the functor K/F ↦ H^1(K,PGL_{n,F})—equivalently, the functor assigning to each field extension K/F the set of isomorphism classes of central simple K-algebras of degree n—determine the essential dimension ed_F(PGL_n) and the essential p-dimension ed_{F,p}(PGL_n). In particular, determine ed_F(PGL_4) for fields F of characteristic 2, and determine ed_F(PGL_5). ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))
equivalent_formulation: Equivalently, for a base field F, compute the essential dimension and essential p-dimension of the functor of central simple algebras of degree n over field extensions K/F; in particular, determine these in the small cases of degree 4 algebras when char(F)=2 and degree 5 algebras. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))
justification: Problem 6.2 in Section 6 is the nearest official formulation to your draft: it asks for the essential dimension and essential p-dimension of PGL_n, and its two explicit subparts are exactly “compute ed(PGL_4) when char(F)=2” and “compute ed(PGL_5).” ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304)) The immediately preceding context defines essential dimension over a base field F, defines essential p-dimension via prime-to-p extensions, and then identifies H^1(-,PGL_n) with the functor of central simple algebras of degree n, so those ingredients are the hidden assumptions needed to make the question stand-alone. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304)) The nearby “What is known” discussion further says that the cases ed(PGL_4) in characteristic 2 and ed(PGL_5) are the smallest unknown cases, confirming that your draft is aimed at this precise open problem rather than a broader neighboring problem about crossed products or small-exponent algebras. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/1006.3304))
